origin.description: Returns the data when there are no problems and raises when there is at least one.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

origin.details: Returns the data when there are no problems and raises when there is at least one.
origin.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
origin.example:
ok <- tryCatch({ stop_for_problems(read_csv(I("a
1"))); "ok" }, error = function(e) "err")
bad <- tryCatch({ stop_for_problems(read_csv(I("a
1
b"), col_types = "d")); "ok" }, error = function(e) "err")
paste(ok, bad)
